content: # U3Si2 as Accident Tolerant Dispersion Fuel Uranium silicide (U3Si2) is a high-uranium-density compound considered for accident-tolerant fuel applications. The tetragonal crystal structure has lattice parameters a=7.332 angstrom and c=3.900 angstrom. The theoretical density of U3Si2 is 12.2 g/cm^3, providing a 25 percent increase in uranium density over UO2. # Thermophysical Properties The thermal conductivity of U3Si2 at 300 K is 8.5 W/(m K). The melting point is 1938 K. The specific heat at 500 K is 0.200 J/(g K). The formation energy from the elements is approximately -85 kJ/mol per uranium atom.
